svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-10
svg.desc: A shared authority-checked damage boundary with attribution and Day 4 smoke validation.
svg.text: 2026-08-10 - One safe, attributable damage boundary
main | commit 38763af | manually reconstructed daily mind map
Daily job
Make every damage producer enter one authority-checked path and preserve source attribution to execution.
Native GAS, AuraAbilityGraph actions, projectiles, debuffs, attributes, tests, and the Day 4 runner were aligned.
BEFORE
Unsafe and bypassable damage
Shared helper assumed valid ASCs/avatars.
CauseDamage could apply directly.
Context lacked role and ability provenance.
Execution and periodic paths could miss current
relationship or life-state changes.
validate then attribute
AFTER
Producer -> boundary -> context -> execution
Validate source/target ASC, avatar, authority, combat rules, and outgoing spec.
Carry ability tag, role ID, controller/player state, zone/event, damage, and impulse data.
Revalidate identity, relationship, life state, profiles, curves, and periodic ticks.
Align direct, projectile, beam, melee, hitscan, radial, and debuff producers.
Rejected damage returns an invalid context and does not apply a GameplayEffect.
Important guard
No client or invalid actor may cross the damage boundary.
Attribution survives from producer to final execution;
missing profile data uses neutral coefficients.
The inventory remains the checklist for future producer migrations.
Validation and reading path
Day 4 automation: 10/10.
Listen and Dedicated damage smoke passed.
Runner checks invalid client requests leave health unchanged.
Read Role-Battle-Damage-Producer-Inventory.md for the full producer table.
